name: cortico-world-coo-home
description:
Bring your current Coopanion character and outfit into a miniature Japanese neighborhood on a rainy night.

• Explore the street. Rotate, zoom, follow your companion, or switch between four wall views to see inside.
• Spend time at home. Click furniture to read, draw, use the computer, watch TV, eat, bathe or sleep. Turn on autonomous life to let your companion tend to its needs.
• Grow a garden. Choose from eight crops for each of eight beds. Sow, water, check ripening times and harvest into your backpack. Spring onion seeds are free.
• Shop at the convenience store. Start with 100 coins, cross the street and sell produce at the counter. Buy seeds or choose from ten foods and drinks to enjoy at home.
• Visit the teahouse. Pick a cushion at Akari no Niwa and sit down for sencha, hojicha or matcha.
• Talk and make plans. Home chat uses your character’s personality and voice. Ask it to plant the empty beds, edit the home prompt, enable AI planning or receive garden updates from your desktop companion.

Home keeps its own chat and save. Life continues when the page is closed.

zh.description:
把你在 Coopanion 里选的角色和装扮带进雨夜日式街区，在马路对面的小屋住下。

• 逛街看家：旋转、缩放或跟随角色散步。切换四种墙面视图，看看角色在屋里做什么。
• 居家生活：点家具让 coo 看电脑、读书、画画、看电视、吃饭、洗澡或睡觉。也可以开启自主生活，看它按精力、饱腹、整洁和舒适度安排日常。
• 打理菜园：八块菜畦都能自由选种。播种、浇水、查看成熟时间，再把收成装进背包。小葱种子免费，其余七种可在便利店购买。
• 便利店买卖：带着初始的 100 金币过街，到柜台卖菜、买种子，或挑选十种食品饮料，把饭团、仙贝和牛奶带回家享用。
• 茶房品茶：走进灯乃庭，选一处坐垫，让 coo 坐下来喝煎茶、焙茶或抹茶。
• 聊天与陪伴：沿用当前角色的人格和声音，在独立的家园对话里说“把空田种上小葱”。也可自定义家园提示词、开启 AI 生活计划，让桌宠捎来成熟和采收消息。

家园单独保存聊天和进度。关闭页面后生活仍会推进，下次打开可以接着玩。
